Name: BowlWeight
Purpose: Food tray weight in grams (read-only display)

Name: TareScale
Purpose: Zero the scale (tray must be empty)

Name: FeedDays
Purpose: Day bitmask: Sun=1 Mon=2 Tue=4 Wed=8 Thu=16 Fri=32 Sat=64

Name: PortionSize
Purpose: Motor run time per feed in seconds

Name: AutoFeedOn
Purpose: Master pause switch for scheduled feeding

Name: ReverseUnjam
Purpose: Reverse the motor 1.5 s to clear a jam

Name: BowlVisits
Purpose: Animal visits counted by the IR sensor

Name: JamFault
Purpose: 1 = motor jam could not be cleared

Name: TestAlert
Purpose: Button that sends a test notification
